race.comment: HEED THE OMENS (1) resumes, formerly with Chris Waller and now with Symon Wilde. His form was patchy last time in but his best runs were a level above this. Off a long break and drawn wide here but the stable can get them fit, the market will be the best guide. IBERIAN LYNX (10) broke through for a nice maiden win at Echuca when last seen to continue consistent form. Drawn well and should be able to go on with it. COLT FORTY FIVE (6) is racing very well and should be right there again having just found one better his past two. He'll handle the ground better than most. BIG ROOSTER (2) will be running on and is another adept in the conditions.
